Not cheating. Creatine is one of the most studied supplements out there, and it's legal in every sport I know of. It's not a drug, it just helps your muscles recycle energy a bit faster during hard sets.

As for how much, I don't give amounts for supplements. That one is for a doctor or a registered dietitian, who can set it for you based on your health and what else you take.

If you're thinking about it as a shortcut, the training still has to do the work. It's a small edge on top of consistent lifting, sleep and eating enough protein.
